_: Each AI prompt and the fixed case set that protects it (tools/prompt-cases.mjs; owner, 27 Oct 2026: a prompt change adds the case it fixed, and the set replays on any prompt change). live: manual workflow_dispatch only; compares the selected ref with main on Haiku 5.5 through the API key (.github/workflows/prompt-cases.yml), not a PR check. A prompt in no set: its change says 'Prompt-case: none <why>' until it gets one.

board-words.about: The Central Scout's board search words in each country's language (owner, 12 Nov 2026, asked via AskUserQuestion: "Scout asks once per country (Recommended)"): a local board gave 0 jobs for the English word and 5 for its own; offline stub-client checks of what is sent and what the code keeps.

role-duties.about: Role families follow duties before titles: quality golden 3006's helpdesk role with an SRE title, while #1992's plain SRE case stays sre; offline prompt, schema and stub-client checks.

question-words.about: The queue's question writer for bare field labels (lib/open-wording.js): 'Workload', 'Summary' and a CV heading never reach a drawer as their own label; offline schema, echo and unworded-label checks with a stub client

contact-asks.about: The queue's contact-detail question writer (lib/contact-review.js): rates how many applications for THIS person's roles ask each empty field; offline checks with a stub client that the request carries the roles and the rating drives the label and the missing count (a Windows tester, 3 Nov 2026: a finance profile's GitHub and Website were 'needed by every form')

profile-lines.about: The judge of saved Profile lines (lib/profile-move.js): a letter's lines are prose, never unclear and never moved (a Windows tester, 3 Nov 2026: judged 82, unclear 81); offline schema and stub-client checks, both prompts

consent-choice.about: Exact affirmative consent choices: offline schema and refusal guards, never a factual attestation

form.about: the form answers call (app-core/src/extension.js answerForm): 60 forms of real-sized fields, each field's expected answer

writing.about: prose the app writes for the person: 5 invented cases per feature with the trap a careless writer falls in (tools/free-ai-writing-eval.mjs)

mail.about: the Gmail check's reading: invented emails with a known right answer (tools/mail_eval.py)

question-reuse.about: whether a form question is reusable, one job's or consent (desktop/lib/question-reuse.js): a question about this one employer is one job's even when unnamed (how did you hear, worked here before, which office); stances and facts stay reusable (owner, 28 Oct 2026: the 21-item queue). Replayed before/after on Haiku through claude -p

kit.about: an application kit's letter and answers (src/ai/kit.py draft): answers that rest on a main-CV or Experience bank bullet (owner's case, About you D1b, 28 Oct 2026), no claim nothing states, the letter never recaps the CV's numbers or names a salary. Replayed before/after on the Claude plan (tools/kit-cases.py, $0)

cv-tailor.about: CV tailoring (desktop/lib/cv.js tailor): a learning shapes the summary where the posting asks for it, never a role; an irrelevant learning stays out; no invented figure (owner's cases, About you D1c-1, 28 Oct 2026)

letter.about: The cover letters (desktop/lib/job-letter.js, cover-letter.js): a letter never mentions pay even when the posting asks, a learning shapes the opening only where the posting asks for it, an irrelevant learning stays out, the person's Writing preferences are followed (owner, 28 Oct 2026, About you D1c-2)

learnings.about: what one form fill teaches (desktop/lib/learnings.js): each answer against the kept learnings, given as a closed topic list: same, extends (the AI widens it), conflicts (Two answers), new, or not ours (owned by Your details or Strategy, private, one job's). Travel in 3 wordings, a contract conflict, salary per country, a per-company question, an employment type Strategy owns (owner, 28 Oct 2026, PR B2). Replayed on Haiku through claude -p

title.about: which job titles could fit a search (src/ai/title_triage.py): lenient by the owner's 7 Oct 2026 "Only the location should be strict"; an open or unsolicited application and pre-sales titles for someone who builds the product are left out (rj #3793, 11 Nov 2026: night 42927975750, carpenter in Brussels, software engineer in Amsterdam); a batch where no title fits is answered with none (gp, 12 Nov 2026: replay with tools/pick-cases.py on the Claude plan)

visit-relevant.about: which sites are worth a browser's time for one person's roles and places (src/sources/visits.py relevant(): the visit list and the refused sites' automatic reads): a list where no site fits is answered with none (gp, 12 Nov 2026: one-turn answers kept 3-15 of 15 unrelated sites on 8 of 10 calls; replay with tools/pick-cases.py --step visit on the Claude plan)

place.about: where a job is, for one person's places (src/ai/place_triage.py): a city list without theirs and remote limited elsewhere are out; remote from anywhere inside an anywhere place is in (Zagreb, Helsinki, quality golden 3003/3010; 27 Oct 2026)

portrait.about: Your portrait (desktop/lib/portrait.js): second person, every statement cited, soft skills as observed behaviour never a type label, no demographic or protected facts, contradictions stated as neither (owner, 28 Oct 2026). Offline: fake-client cases check what is sent and what is kept

eures-regions.about: which NUTS-2 region a place lies in (src/sources/eures.py): the AI chooses from the real regions of the place's country, a code no region has is dropped and a kept one is asked again (#2918: the same Toulouse got FRJ2 in 2 installs and FR61, no real code, in 2); offline stub-client checks

score.about: the fit score's search part (src/ai/score_search.py, score.py): a role that needs a licence, certification or rating the person does not hold is capped at 49 (owner, 7 Nov 2026: a Cessna captain job scored 85 while its card said Not eligible); a scheme that trains from zero, a job in the person's own field, a language gap (49 cap) and a missing tool keep their bands. Replay: tools/score-cases.py on the Claude plan ($0).

strategy-draft.about: the strategy draft's search part (desktop/lib/strategy.js INSTRUCTIONS): country_wide stays [] unless the CV or note says they would work anywhere in the country, Remote jobs No / Country / Yes from the work mode (lj 2/4, 10 Nov 2026: 16 of 18 drafts filled the whole country; rj #3792, 11 Nov 2026: office roles in Cluj, Amsterdam, Lisbon still got it; pp, #3953 follow-up: run 43328194035 p10 drafted places ["lisb(on|oa)"]: each place is one plain name, two spellings two entries; pp, 13 Nov 2026: a first search asks a board only the first 2 titles, so the local-language title comes first and is the title most local ads use, never a broader word like "шофьор"; sa, run 43343062154: Krakow's chef de partie drafted as the literal "szef sekcji kuchennej" (1 job), a rank inside a trade becomes the trade's common title "kucharz"; Gitar on #3956: the first drafted title of a non-English-CV market (Sofia, Krakow, as drafted in run 43348554638) is the first board word)

persona-completion.about: Persona completion evidence: the 8 Nov false Spanish success and unsupported bug verdict remain unverified; offline scripted answers, no paid model evaluation.

title-field.about: A one-posting job page's JSON-LD title: a role, or an unfilled template field such as HV_JSON_TITULO (jobadabra-lab board-discovery run 43502695338); offline stub-client checks of what is asked, what is kept and how often.
